about: Vendor registry for tools/af_advisor.py. One entry per vendor, one reason per dead vendor. Every score here was written by a bench run (af_vendor_bench.py / af_ceo_bench.py / af_pick_trading_advisor.py --write), never typed by hand.

current.text: When a step is blocked, ask the advisor TEAM, not Gemini alone: consult every live vendor (Gemini, KiloCode, G4FSpace, Yqcloud, pollinations) and act on the answer when a quorum agrees. A single vendor is only for a quick second opinion, never for a blocker.

superseded.text: The advisor team is Gemini alone; when a step is blocked, ask Gemini and follow what it says.
superseded.still_reachable: python3 tools/af_advisor.py --advisor gemini (a single vendor is still one way to ask)

superseded.text: A non-trivial task needs a quorum of >= 5 vendor channels before acting.

rules: Free only: no paid API, no subscription, no credits.
If an instruction cannot be carried out, record which step failed and ask again with the real error. Never change the plan silently.
Never invent an advisor answer. If nobody answers, exit non-zero.
A failed pipe and a wrong answer are different faults: retry or switch transport for the first, re-ask or re-grade for the second. Never drop a vendor over one failed call.
A bench score is evidence, not a verdict: one round swings about +/-2 points, so decide on the median of three rounds.

Gemini.note: Rank 1 standing advisor (K, 2026-11-18). 11/12 CEO and 11/11 trading on the 2026-11-21 bench; it took the trading-advisor slot on the tie-break, not on a higher score.

KiloCode.note: Fastest of the g4f vendors measured 2026-11-21 (2-4 s per answer).

G4FSpace.note: Stands in for CohereForAI_C4AI_Command, dead since 2026-11-13. 11/12 CEO and 11/11 trading on 2026-11-21. Intermittently answers with a 584-character 'Copilot moved to a new app' advert instead of an answer (four consecutive calls 18:05-18:20 on 2026-11-21, clean again at 18:25); the advert guard turns those into retries instead of counting junk as advice.

pollinations.note: Keyless HTTPS and the only vendor that does not depend on g4f, so it is the fallback when g4f breaks. Top CEO score on 2026-11-21 (12/12: the only vendor that named the 4.5/hour opportunity cost) but the slowest at 55-105 s per call under the free tier's one-call-per-45 s window.

Yqcloud.note: 11/12 CEO and 10/11 trading on 2026-11-21. Solid, never top: it missed the opportunity-cost check on sayno.

CohereForAI_C4AI_Command.reason: AttributeError: 'Conversation' object has no attribute 'cookies' — the provider's own session handling broke, not a quota.

LLM7.reason: HTTP 429 on every attempt; the free quota is gone, so it answers nothing.

ceo.note: Median of the rounds, not a single run: one round swings +/-2.

trading_advisor.note: Written by af_pick_trading_advisor.py --write: highest median points; ties go to self-consistency, then to the standing advisor.
